channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Amare Stoudemire | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Amare Stoudemire from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill
item.description:
Goran Dragic on Udonis Haslem continued:

“A lot of guys in this locker room need leadership like UD, especially Hassan [Whiteside]. I think UD can provide that. He's there where usually some guys would not be, in the toughest moments, when you need something, he's there. That's why everybody loves him. I played with a lot of veteran guys who had successful careers — like UD, Steve Nash, Grant Hill, Amare Stoudemire — [and Haslem] is number one in my books as a player and a leader and a friend.”

Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill, May 11, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Steve Mills on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
“For parts of six years, Amar’e Stoudemire was the face of the New York Knicks franchise because of his excellence on the court and his dedication to our community and our fans across the world. When Amar’e asked us to retire as a Knick, we were honored to oblige,”

Steve Mills on Amare Stoudemire, Jul 26, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Amin Elhassan on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
Amin Elhassan:

“I lived it. We had Amar'e Stoudemire in Phoenix. He had great years here, all-NBA years here, All-Star years next to Steve Nash. We offered a $100 million deal that was partially guaranteed. When I say partially I mean about 75 percent guaranteed. It was a good deal and a smart deal on our part because he had a medical history and what happened? The Knicks said,”

Amin Elhassan on Amare Stoudemire, Apr 8, 2016. Source: CSNMidAtlantic.

item.title: Joe Johnson on Amare Stoudemire, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem
item.description:
The versatile swingman, who started in his first game with the Heat on Sunday against the New York Knicks, hopes to finish his career in Miami.

“Man, I had a connection with a lot of guys here. D-Wade, [Amar'e Stoudemire], UD [Udonis Haslem], guys I've been in contact with. Not just throughout this process, but over the years, and I just felt it was right,”

Joe Johnson on Amare Stoudemire, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem, Feb 28, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Tyson Chandler on Amar'e Stoudemire's comments:

“He came here because he wants to win a championship. I encourage more guys to be vocal.”

Tyson Chandler on Amare Stoudemire, Mar 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Amar'e Stoudemire:

“The one thing I can say at this point is we’re optimistic that something’s going to happen.”

Rick Carlisle on Amare Stoudemire, Feb 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
“[Stoudemire] wants to play for a championship, he wants to play for a contender, so I don't think nobody should hold that back from him,”

Carmelo Anthony on Amare Stoudemire, Feb 16, 2015. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
“I’m not saying [Stoudemire] wasn’t a good fit. I’m saying that’s the way I decided to go.”

Mike Woodson on Amare Stoudemire, Mar 4, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash
item.description:
“You’ve got a guy by the name of Steve Nash who’s orchestrating the offense,’’ Stoudemire said. “Things seem to run a little smoother when he’s got control of the ball. But we’ll get there.’’When? D’Antoni said if Davis can start practicing by the end of this month it should help. “ I just don’t want to go there yet until I see him [Davis] on the floor,”

Mike D'Antoni on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Jan 18, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Amare Stoudemire
item.description:
Sam Amico:Charles Barkley on Amare Stoudemire's idea to start new league:

“One of the stupidest things I've ever heard. That's up there with new Coke”

Charles Barkley on Amare Stoudemire, Oct 17, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Barkley on Amar'e Stoudemire and Carmelo Anthony talking about starting a new league:

“That's right up there as one of the stupidest things I've ever heard. That's right up there with new Coke.”

Charles Barkley on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony, Oct 14, 2011. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
“Both of those men, Carmelo and Stoudemire even with Chauncey (Billups), their mentality is they want to win. Carmelo's won in college. He understands how to win. They're tough enough to go out and win and win big and have big moments in playoff situations.”

Isiah Thomas on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony, Oct 10, 2011. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Dwight Howard on the chemistry between Stoudemire and Carmelo Anthony:

“It's going to take a while for those guys to get used to playing with each other. You just gotta be patient. But they're a tough team. They're going to be very tough in the playoffs just once they learn how to really play together, but it takes a while. We're going through the same thing right now with a lot of new guys, so we all understand the position that they're in. Just like I said, they gotta stick with it.”

Dwight Howard on Amare Stoudemire, Carmelo Anthony, Mar 24, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
